testcase.name: performUndoRestore RejectedBeforeMutation maps to IoFailure and keeps the retry slot()
a committed RESERVATION-sourced rollback keeps the previous restore's still-valid undo()
recovery path survives a process restart after FailedAfterMutation()
the undo claims the journal as its own Rollback attempt before mutating()
[1] RejectedBeforeMutation(error=CorruptedBackup(reason=journal-named rollback source is missing), effectsError=null)
[2] FailedAfterMutation(error=Io(cause=java.io.IOException: disk full), effectsError=null)
[3] RecoveredByRollback(error=Io(cause=java.io.IOException: swap failed post-PONR), effectsError=null)
[4] FatalNoGeneration(effectsError=null)
a COMMITTED attempt whose peek fails recovers()
restartApp delegates to the AppReinitializer seam()
success finalization cleans up the RETAINED reservation copy idempotently()
an interrupted but COMMITTED rollback is finished, never re-driven()
scenario-1 compensation is PACKAGED in the effects object - nothing runs post-await()
a COMMITTED attempt recovers from the CANONICAL slot - its promotion is durably done()
a COMMITTED attempt with no context cannot be verified and recovers()
a committed EXPLICIT-source rollback with no canonical clears availability()
the rollback uses the attempt's reserved snapshot path()
performUndoRestore returns FileMissing when no preserved backup exists()
a COMMITTED attempt verifies by peek and succeeds()
undo compensation is PACKAGED in the effects object - nothing runs post-await()
the recovery re-claim CHECKS ownership - a foreign-owned slot rejects before mutating()
success finalization is data-bearing-first - the attempt resolves LAST()
handlePostRestoreLaunch with no unresolved attempt is a no-op()
the LEGACY marker's recovery completes end-to-end under the synthetic owner id()
a PREPARED attempt never peeks the schema and never claims success()
performUndoRestore FailedAfterMutation maps to IoFailure and deletes nothing()
a finalization failure never leaves the journal resolved with the undo hidden()
performUndoRestore happy path - clear, publish, resolve LAST, THEN acknowledge()
a rollback that commits without a durable record requires recovery()
a committed-rollback finalization failure keeps the journal - the replay is idempotent()
